notes.title: New Localizations and build update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989394/cb7e1321a47998403990388bf5fe8d2ca6d6d6b0.jpg[/img]

[olist]
[*] Build Version change to 23.0
[*] New language versions are now available in English (EN), Spanish (ES), French (FR), German (DE), Korean (KO), Japanese (JP), and Simplified Chinese (CN), which can be changed during the first login or in the language setting from the menu at the top right of the main page. Please note that you will need to download the resources every time when you change the language setting.
[*] The title’s Frame has been added, it will be changed at the same time when the title is set.
[*] Related newbie systems are grouped into one entrance, the "Newbie Events" icon
[list][*]  It is located in the lower left corner of the main page. Players can jump to other newbie systems [/list]by clicking on the banner in this entrance.
[*] Newbie Time-Limited Gacha is added for new players to get the selectable Year III characters.
[list]
[*] An entrance will be added to the "Newbie Events" icon.
[*] A time countdown is started when players create a new account.
[*] Players must choose an item as a target reward, they will be able to receive the target rewards after a certain number of draws.
[*] Target rewards can be changed at any time without affecting the accumulated amount of Gacha being drawn.
[*] There is a limit to how many target rewards players can receive, and the rewards will not be drawn if the limit is reached.
[/list]
[*] Newbie Shop is added to the "Newbie Events" icon
[list][*] Additional Spending Rewards
[*] Players can receive fabulous bonus rewards, including limited and carnival Year III characters by spending a certain amount of DMM points in a limited time. 
[*] Countdown time will reset when players enter the next step.
[*] Entrance is added on the top left corner of the main page.[/list]
[*] Special offer package
[list]
[*] An entrance will be added to the right of the main page.
[*] It has been divided into two types of packages: the top one is General Packages and the bottom one is Combo-Package.
[*] Combo-Package cannot be purchased after one of the General Packages has been purchased.
[*] Purchasing the Combo-Packages is the same as purchasing all the General Packages at a discounted price, and players will receive additional rewards.
[/list]
[/olist]

Thank you,
The Project QT Team <3

notes.title: Major update, Senpai!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989394/96a99f399105c914ae8d42313ce5dbe6ceb9127f.jpg[/img]

Hiii, Senpai! 
Guess what?! This month we’re celebrating 200 days of Project QT  that could only mean one thing, Senpai ヽ(>∀<☆)ノ Things are getting kinkier and kinkier… and we know you’re ready for it ~

This week’s all about your spicy marriage with Alberta, limited summons, lewd rewards and epic deals. Don’t miss out!
[i]Halloween Witches Limited Summon & Wind Awaken Pack period: August 5th ~ 19th.
Amy Drop Rate Up Summon Event period: 6th ~ 11th.
Special Discount Pack period: August 8th ~ 17th.
Alberta's Love Forever event period: August 9th ~ 20th.
200 day launch Pack period: August 10th ~ 25th.[/i]

 
Changelog for the update:
[list]
[*] Build Version change to 21.5
[*] Historic Event entrance is added at Main UI on the right side
[*] Dungeons entrance is added
[*] Player rank limit increases to 250
[*] Bag Setting: Skin Fragments can be hidden
[*] Items can be exchanged multiple times at once in the Item Exchange Event
[*] Relive story function in FAP, Multiversal Dating, Erotic Lens events
[*] “Newbie mission” will add to 14 days. And the entrance moves to the lower left corner, on top of the redirect banner.
[*] The display method of opening the Select Box is optimized.
[*] The current character's 5-star skills are displayed in the Step-Up summon pool and Carnival Shop.
[*] New rewards will be added in main chapters 2 to 7. Rewards for players who complete these chapters will be distributed by mail.
[*] New function: Battle data review is added. Players can review the battle details after playing Arena and Grand Arena.
[*] New function: Home Page button is added between the button of Main Page and Character Page. Players can set their character (with skins or not) to be shown on Home Page.
[*] 3x speed function has been added, which can be turned on when both Golden & Monthly Card are active at the same time.
[*] Added more instruction on combat’s status, and the combat animation will be paused when reading it.
[*] Supports opening 500 boxes at once.
[/list]

notes.title: ★Community Update★
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43989394/42b9e2cc30af03552817051c8109c19cb96fb8c3.jpg[/img]

Heya, QTies! ヾ(・ω・*)

We’re always all ears to your voice, and your feedback means the world to us! So, let’s dive into two of the main topics that have been quite popular lately:

To begin with, let’s talk about the “pay to win” blocker that some of you have been encountering. We totally get it, it can feel like hitting a wall sometimes, where progress seems tied to paid features. But fear not! The devs are aware of your feedback, and they are doing their best to smooth things out in future builds.

On a brighter note, we’re thrilled to hear how much you love the girls of the QTverse. Get ready because more stunning beauties are headed your way!

To wrap it up, we’ve got lots of plans lined up for the months ahead. Bigger, better, and even kinkier adventures await you, so keep an eye out for the latest updates about Project QT! ❤︎


The Project QT Team
